items.Title: Business Relationship Manager Senior
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
If you are customer focused, enjoy building relationships and providing financial advice to your clients, then a role as a Business Relationship Manager is for you.


As a Business Relationship Manager Senior (Sr. BRM) in Business Banking, you’ll be managing and developing a portfolio of large profitable business clients with annual revenue greater than 3MM+ . You’ll focus on business development, deposit/balance acquisition, product deepening, client retention and growth, and gaining referrals to increase primary bank share. As a Sr. BRM, you will provide a high-touch experience by building relationships and providing financial advice with a focus on client experience and risk management—while retaining and deepening existing relationships and acquiring new relationships through targeted prospecting and referrals.
